snippet.title: Nightfall Berlin - Prototype Teaser Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Play the prototype and tell me what you think: https://heartcasegames.itch.io/nightfall-berlin !

An occult detective RPG set in a dark reflection of 90s Berlin.

Inspired by Vampire the Masquerade, Deus Ex and Hellblazer, it weaves a tale of conspiracy that combines Germanic folklore with neo-noir themes, connected to the dynamic, seductive and violent history of Berlin.
